verdicts.reason: A shrinks the Enter Now CTA and the LIMITED badge to unreadable specks under the tiny shoe. That buries the call to action, and the three-line subcopy on the right ends up competing with the headline. B keeps the CTA as a legible lime pill, but the LIMITED badge is now as large as the CTA and competes with it. B's subcopy wraps awkwardly, leaving 'Thursday.' alone on its own line, the headline is jammed against the left edge, and the shoe is shrunk to an icon, so B still needs fixes before it could ship.
